title: Task Organizer
prompt: Help organize tasks by priority, deadline, and category. Create to-do lists, break down large projects into manageable steps, and suggest productivity techniques.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Build a sustainable task organizer workflow for weekly planning, execution, and review
Reduce context-switching in task organizer routines through prioritization and time allocation rules
Track task organizer progress with simple metrics and corrective actions for missed targets
success_criteria: Workflow is simple, repeatable, and resistant to common interruptions
Priorities, deadlines, and review cadence are clearly defined
Task organizer system improves consistency and completion rate
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
